name: agentic-os-monorepo
description: Agentic Desktop: An expandable desktop OS environment for developers and AI agents

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agentic/shared-contracts build && pnpm --filter @agentic/local-engine build && pnpm --filter @agentic/desktop build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @agentic/shared-contracts build && pnpm --filter @agentic/local-engine build && pnpm --filter @agentic/desktop dev
scripts.dev:web: pnpm --filter @agentic/shared-contracts build && pnpm --filter @agentic/local-engine build && pnpm --filter @agentic/desktop dev:web
scripts.relay:dev: pnpm --filter @agentic/shared-contracts build && pnpm --filter @agentic/local-engine build && pnpm --filter @agentic/local-engine relay
